score_matrix.rationale: Mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowed-file scope, and schema preservation. The bounded fixture meaningfully advances the cancellation handoff with concrete identity, replay, crash-recovery, occupancy, and negative controls. It preserves Open status, historical records, ordinary admission, and operator approval gates. The contribution specifies verification rather than supplying behavioral evidence.
risks: The acceptance slice remains unexecuted; it establishes no passing cancellation behavior, deployed coverage, or authorization to retire blockers.

score_matrix.rationale: Mechanical validation passes (applies, allowlist, schema). The patch is documentation-only, confined to the UBU-Q0163 block, keeps Status: Open with the single-line metadata intact, resolves nothing, adds no decisions, and claims no passing results or operator approval, which is the correct posture for a human-approval Process question. It is directly responsive: it turns the audit's identified cancellation/retirement gap into a concrete, auditable acceptance table (capture/restart lineage, explicit cancellation via the wire adapter including the no-dateTime case, replay idempotence, crash consistency, incomplete-list/out-of-horizon/unsupported-input controls, and rejected-evidence controls) plus planner-occupancy probes tied to the existing Dynamic-placement control. The observation that a mock feeding already-parsed events bypasses the gap because parse_event_with_diagnostic drops cancelled entries is accurate and useful. Downsides are partial redundancy with the existing handoff paragraph, some design-level requirements living in the question rather than the decision, and a few prescriptive fixture details that may exceed what the harness supports. Net: valid, minimal, auditable, responsive, with modest drift and over-specification risk.
required_fixes: None blocking. Optional: fold the overlapping sentences of the existing handoff paragraph into the new slice (or reference it) so there is one reproduction spec per block.

Optional: state whether the evidence-binding requirements are drawn from UBU-D0318 or are new; if new, mark them as proposed and route them to the decision record rather than leaving them as implicit policy in the question.
risks: The new slice overlaps the existing 'implementation handoff' paragraph in the same block; two overlapping specifications for the same reproduction can drift apart over later edits.

Normative adapter requirements (binding cancellation evidence to account/calendar, occurrence identity, source revision/ordering and admitted Task version) are design-level content placed in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md rather than in UBU-D0318/DESIGN.md, so they may be missed or conflict with the canonical retirement specification.

Several required results (interrupting admission before/after durable commit, probing every enabled planner backend, fixed clock at 2026-10-19T09:00:00Z) assume harness capabilities the orchestrator may not have; if infeasible as written the slice could stall rather than guide work.
The block grows by 19 lines in an already dense question; readability of UBU-Q0163 keeps degrading.
